editor.name: svelte-jsoneditor
editor.note: The editor source is included under vendor/svelte-jsoneditor with local changes, listed in vendor/svelte-jsoneditor/CHANGES.

components.name: Microsoft WebView2 SDK (WebView2LoaderStatic.lib)
components.note: The WebView2 loader library is statically linked into the executable through the webview2-com-sys crate. The text is the LICENSE.txt of the Microsoft.Web.WebView2 package.

components.name: Font Awesome Free icons
components.note: Icons by Font Awesome (https://fontawesome.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Used through the @fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons and @fortawesome/free-regular-svg-icons packages, listed below.

components.name: diff-sequences
components.note: A build of this package is included in the editor as vendor/svelte-jsoneditor/src/lib/generated/diffSequence.js.

alloc-stdlib.why: The text is the LICENSE of alloc-no-stdlib, from the same repository (https://github.com/dropbox/rust-alloc-no-stdlib).

selectors.why: The text is the standard Mozilla Public License 2.0. Source code: https://crates.io/crates/selectors/0.38.0 and https://github.com/servo/stylo.

tauri-plugin.why: The texts are the license files of tauri, from the same repository (https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri).

webview2-com.why: The text is the LICENSE of the repository https://github.com/wravery/webview2-rs.

webview2-com-macros.why: The text is the LICENSE of the repository https://github.com/wravery/webview2-rs.

webview2-com-sys.why: The text is the LICENSE of the repository https://github.com/wravery/webview2-rs. The Microsoft WebView2 SDK part is listed separately above.
